Remark
[Continuous principal coefficients] 1. ch8:8.9\group ch08-generalized-solutions For sufficiently smooth $\partial \Omega $ and $\varphi \in W^{2,2}(\Omega )$, the same conclusion holds with only $a^{ij}\in C^0(\overline\Omega )$; this is the later global result cited as Theorem 9.15 in the baseline.
